statement:
∀ x : Fin 4 → ℤ → ℝ, (∀ i, KdVPlan.NonnegL2 (x i)) →
∀ (A : Set (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)) (F : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)),
(∑ z ∈ F, KdVPlan.quadTerm A (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z) ≤
(24*4*(3/(1-(Real.sqrt 2)⁻¹))) * ∏ i : Fin 4, KdVPlan.seqN (x i)
proof:
intro x hx A F
classical
let v : (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) → Fin 4 → ℤ := fun z => ![z.1,z.2.1,z.2.2,-z.1-z.2.1-z.2.2]
let B : Finset ℤ := F.biUnion (fun z => {z.1,z.2.1,z.2.2,-z.1-z.2.1-z.2.2})
let G : Finset (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) := F.filter (fun z => z ∈ A ∧ KdVPlan.Interaction z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2 (-z.1-z.2.1-z.2.2))
have hg : ∀ z : G, (z:ℤ × ℤ × ℤ) ∈ A ∧ KdVPlan.Interaction z.val.1 z.val.2.1 z.val.2.2 (-z.val.1-z.val.2.1-z.val.2.2) := by
  intro z
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp z.property).2
have hmem : ∀ z ∈ F, ∀ i : Fin 4, v z i ∈ B := by
  intro z hz i
  apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨z,hz,?_⟩
  fin_cases i <;> simp [v]
have hne : ∀ z : G, ∀ i : Fin 4, v z.val i ≠ 0 := by
  intro z i
  rcases (hg z).2 with ⟨hs,h0,h1,h2,h3⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2
  · exact h3
have hf : ∀ z : G, ∀ i : Fin 4, v z.val i ∈ B.erase 0 := by
  intro z i
  exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne z i, hmem z.val (Finset.mem_filter.mp z.property).1 i⟩
let f : G → (Fin 4 → (B.erase 0)) := fun z i => ⟨v z.val i, hf z i⟩
have hfinj : Function.Injective f := by
  intro z w he
  have h0 : z.val.1=w.val.1 := congrArg (fun t : Fin 4 → (B.erase 0) => (t 0:ℤ)) he
  have h1 : z.val.2.1=w.val.2.1 := congrArg (fun t : Fin 4 → (B.erase 0) => (t 1:ℤ)) he
  have h2 : z.val.2.2=w.val.2.2 := congrArg (fun t : Fin 4 → (B.erase 0) => (t 2:ℤ)) he
  exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h0 (Prod.ext h1 h2))
let H : (Fin 4 → (B.erase 0)) → ℝ := fun a =>
  if (∑ i : Fin 4, (a i:ℤ))=0 then
    (∏ i : Fin 4, x i (a i))/KdVPlan.n3 (a 0) (a 1) (a 2) (a 3) else 0
have hH : ∀ a, 0 ≤ H a := by
  intro a
  dsimp [H]
  split_ifs
  · apply div_nonneg
    · exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun i hi => (hx i).2.1 (a i)
    · unfold KdVPlan.n3
      positivity
  · exact le_rfl
have heval : ∀ z : G, H (f z) = KdVPlan.quadTerm A (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z.val := by
  intro z
  have hzero : (∑ i : Fin 4, (f z i:ℤ))=0 := by
    simp [f, v, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
  have hz := hg z
  simp [H, hzero, KdVPlan.quadTerm, hz, f, v, Fin.prod_univ_succ, mul_assoc]
have hG : (∑ z ∈ F, KdVPlan.quadTerm A (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z) =
    ∑ z : G, KdVPlan.quadTerm A (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z.val := by
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort G (KdVPlan.quadTerm A (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3))]
  dsimp [G]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z hz
  by_cases hc : z ∈ A ∧ KdVPlan.Interaction z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2 (-z.1-z.2.1-z.2.2)
  · simp only [hc, ite_true]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.quadTerm, hc, ite_false]
calc
  _ = ∑ z : G, H (f z) := hG.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z hz => (heval z).symm))
  _ = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.image f, H a := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact hfinj hab
  _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 4 → (B.erase 0), H a :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _) (fun a ha hnot => hH a)
  _ ≤ _ := @yui_aux_0028 T gamma R B x hx
